title: PSX-style isometric zombie colony builder
author: muhammetkir
selftext:
Small browser game where you send survivors out to gather by day, defend the walls at night and grow a camp into a fortified town across the seasons. You only build your camp and set the jobs (how many people will do that job). Video show the 1 year of the game as 50x speed.

**Tools:** Claude Code (desktop app) for nearly all the code. Three.js loaded as plain ES modules with no build step, a tiny Python static server, WebAudio

**Process:** I described features in plain language one at a time (day/night, guards, farming, wall tiers, seasons, save slots). After each one, Claude tested it in a separate browser tab with a scripted bot that simulated several nights and reported deaths, food and wall losses. That loop is also how I tuned the difficulty so the early game is barely survivable.
